lines.en-US: Of a giant bird on the dark side of the moon.

You move about Naraka, getting entangled

lines.zh-CN: 顺着这股势头，径直冲破吧。
lines.en-US: With all the life in you, outrun them!
When you tie up the blue emblem,

lines.japanese: 呼吸を深く、両の眼は閉じて。

lines.en-US: Take a deep breath and close both eyes.

You take a trial run with depravity, squeezing it dry.

lines.en-US: What exactly is gonna change? Will you even feel like being saved?

lines.en-US: As you always have, you spat out,
“They live off gratitude.”
May your blade kill the wind itself.

lines.en-US: Even karma wielding its polished mirror and flee!

lines.zh-CN: 用尽苦肉之计苦思冥想
lines.en-US: You think in terms of last resorts.
